name: Business
summary: The player's team: money (prize money in, R&D spending out), car upgrades (engine, aero, brakes, suspension, weight, tyres; levels 0-3) and liveries, saved on the player's machine (user://profile.json).
notes: Upgrades change cars only through CarDefinition.with_overrides(): UpgradeCatalog.overrides_for(def, levels) returns the overrides (plus a 'visual' block for the 3D parts). Data: data/upgrades.json (levels, prices, prize table, livery palette). Pure data, no nodes. The garage screen lives in the ui module. See docs/BUSINESS.md.
